MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Issue Preclusion
📚 核心考点：争点排除 (Issue Preclusion / Collateral Estoppel)

争点排除规则禁止对先前诉讼中已经裁决过的问题进行重新诉讼。要适用该规则，必须满足以下条件：

  • 相同争点 (Same Issue)：两起诉讼涉及的事实或法律问题相同。
  • 实际诉讼 (Actually Litigated)：该争点在第一起诉讼中被实际提出并辩论。
  • 实际裁决 (Actually Determined)：法院或陪审团对该争点作出了明确认定。
  • 对判决必要 (Essential to the Judgment)：该争点的认定是第一起判决结果的必要组成部分。
🕵️‍♂️ 案情逻辑分析

第一起诉讼 (Woman v. Manufacturer)：

  • 结果：原告胜诉。
  • 关键认定：陪审团明确认定“制造商设计过失”且“原告无过失”。
  • 必要性：在过失侵权诉讼中，如果认定被告没有过失，原告不可能胜诉。因此，认定“制造商有过失”对于判决结果是绝对必要 (Essential) 的。

第二起诉讼 (Man v. Manufacturer)：

  • 关系：新原告起诉同一被告。
  • 规则环境：State A 允许非共同当事人 (Nonmutual) 争点排除。这意味着即使该男性不是第一起案件的当事人，他也可以利用第一起案件的判决来针对制造商。
✅ 正确答案解析
选项 D 正确

理由：陪审团在第一起诉讼中已经实际认定制造商在刹车设计上存在过失。因为第一起诉讼是基于过失责任的，所以这一认定对于支持该女性的胜诉判决是必要 (Essential) 的。

由于 State A 允许非共同当事人使用争点排除（即进攻性争点排除，Offensive Collateral Estoppel），该男性可以直接利用这一认定，法院应给予其排除效力。

❌ 错误选项排除
选项 A 错误

错误点：认为该认定“非必要”。
解析：如果陪审团没有认定制造商有过失，该女性就不可能赢得官司。因此，该认定是判决的基础，属于“必要”争点。

选项 B 错误

错误点：互惠性 (Mutuality) 要求。
解析：题目明确指出 State A 允许“非共同当事人争点排除”。因此，该男性作为新原告，不需要是第一起案件的当事人即可使用该判决。

选项 C 错误

错误点：逻辑重心偏差。
解析：虽然法院在决定是否允许“进攻性”争点排除时，会考虑原告是否采取了“观望态度” (wait and see)，但该男性无法加入第一起诉讼只是法院行使自由裁量权的一个有利因素，并非争点排除生效的法律依据。生效的根本原因是争点已被裁决且必要。

💡 MBE 提分技巧：

在处理 Issue Preclusion 题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看当事人：是被告在之前的案子里输了吗？如果是，检查题目是否允许 "Nonmutual"（非共同）排除。
  2. 看必要性 (Essential)：如果之前的判决是基于多个理由，或者该争点的认定与最终判决结果相反（例如：认定被告有过失，但原告因诉讼时效已过而败诉），那么该过失认定通常不是必要的，不能产生排除效力。
  3. 看进攻 vs 防御：
    🛡️ 防御性 (Defensive)：被告用前案阻挡原告（通常允许）。
    ⚔️ 进攻性 (Offensive)：新原告用前案攻击被告（本题情况，需法院裁量，通常要求被告在前案中有充分抗辩机会）。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A drunken man confronted a heavyweight boxer in a bar, and a fight ensued. During the melee, the boxer struck the man's head and the man instantly died. The boxer was convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to 15 years in prison.
While the boxer was serving his sentence, the man's spouse brought a wrongful death suit against the boxer in federal court. The spouse sought $10 million in damages for loss of future income and loss of companionship. The boxer was served with process while in prison, but he did not respond. Thirty days later, the spouse asked the clerk to enter the boxer's default, and the clerk did so. The spouse then applied to the clerk to enter a default judgment.
May the clerk enter a default judgment?

choices.A: No, because the boxer was not given notice of the spouse's application for the entry of default judgment.
choices.B: No, because the spouse did not seek a sum certain or attach an affidavit showing the amount due.
choices.C: Yes, because the boxer failed to appear.
choices.D: Yes, because the clerk may set damages at the amount demanded in the complaint.

questions.explanation:
Entering default judgment
Δ failed to timely serve answer
No → No default
Yes
Clerk must enter default into record
↓
  • π's claim is for sum certain
  • π's affidavit establishes amount due
  • Δ failed to appear and
  • Δ not minor or incompetent
Yes → Clerk must enter
default judgment
↓
  • If Δ appeared, served written notice
    7 days before hearing
  • If Δ minor or incompetent, represented
    by guardian
No → No default
judgment
↓
Court may enter default judgment

Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 55 provides a two-step process for a plaintiff to secure a default judgment. First, the clerk must enter the defendant's default into the record once the plaintiff shows that the defendant failed to timely serve an answer—as the boxer failed to do within 21 days after being served with process. Second, the court or the clerk may enter a default judgment. However, the clerk is prohibited from doing so if any of the following apply:

  • The defendant has appeared—ie, filed a motion or otherwise acted before the court.
  • The defendant is legally incompetent or a minor.
  • The plaintiff's claim is not for a sum certain (ie, a specified or set amount) or sum that can be made certain by calculation.
  • The plaintiff failed to include an affidavit establishing the amount due.

Here, the boxer did not appear, and there is no indication that he is legally incompetent or a minor. However, the spouse's request for $10 million is not a sum certain and cannot be made certain by calculation. That is because the man's future earning potential and the value of his companionship are not specified or set amounts. Additionally, the spouse failed to attach an affidavit showing the amount due. Therefore, the clerk may not enter a default judgment (Choice C).*

*The court may still enter a default judgment after the judge conducts a hearing to determine the proper amount of damages to award.

(Choice A) Had the boxer appeared, he would have been entitled to written notice at least seven days before the court conducted a hearing on the entry of default judgment.

(Choice D) The clerk may set damages at the amount demanded in the complaint when the claim is for a sum certain and an attached affidavit establishes the amount due—neither of which is seen here.

📌 Educational Objective

A default judgment may be entered by the clerk of the court unless: (1) the defendant has appeared, (2) the defendant is legally incompetent or a minor, (3) the plaintiff's claim is not for a sum certain or a sum that can be made certain by calculation, or (4) the plaintiff failed to include an affidavit establishing the amount due.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 55 (default judgments).
  • 46 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 260 (2019) (explaining sum certain).
questions.zh-question:
一名醉汉在酒吧与一名重量级拳击手发生冲突，继而引发斗殴。在混战中，拳击手击中该男子的头部，导致其当场死亡。该拳击手被判过失杀人罪 (manslaughter) 成立，并被判处15年监禁。

在该拳击手服刑期间，死者的配偶在联邦法院对他提起了非正常死亡之诉 (wrongful death suit)。该配偶要求1000万美元的损害赔偿，以弥补未来收入损失和陪伴损失。该拳击手在狱中收到了诉讼文书送达，但他没有回应。三十天后，该配偶请求书记员记录该拳击手的缺席，书记员照办了。随后，该配偶向书记员申请作出缺席判决 (default judgment)。

书记员可以作出缺席判决吗？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为该拳击手未收到配偶申请作出缺席判决的通知。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为该配偶寻求的不是一笔固定数额的款项，也未附上显示到期金额的宣誓书。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为该拳击手未出庭。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为书记员可以根据诉状中要求的金额来确定损害赔偿金。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Default Judgment

正确答案
选项 B
不可以，因为该配偶寻求的不是一笔固定数额的款项 (Sum Certain)，也未附上显示到期金额的宣誓书。
⚖️ 核心考点：FRCP 55

在联邦民事诉讼规则下，获得缺席判决 (Default Judgment) 分为两步。关键在于区分书记员 (Clerk) 的权限与法院/法官 (Court) 的权限。

1. 缺席记录 (Entry of Default)
由书记员执行（若被告未答辩）
⬇
2. 缺席判决 (Default Judgment)
谁来作出？
书记员 (Clerk) 仅在满足所有以下条件时可作出判决：
  • 原告的请求是针对固定数额 (Sum Certain)；
  • 原告提供了确定金额的宣誓书 (Affidavit)；
  • 被告未出庭 (Failed to Appear)；
  • 被告不是未成年人或无行为能力人。
如果不满足上述任一条件 ➔ 必须由法官 (Court) 裁决
🔍 案情分析

本案中，原告提起的是非正常死亡之诉 (Wrongful Death)，要求赔偿：

  • 未来收入损失 (Loss of future income)
  • 陪伴损失 (Loss of companionship)

关键点：这些损害赔偿属于非清理损害赔偿 (Unliquidated Damages)。

虽然诉状中写了“1000万美元”，但这只是原告的主张，并非通过简单计算（如合同欠款、票据金额）就能确定的 Sum Certain。这种赔偿需要法官举行听证会，评估证据后才能确定具体数额。因此，书记员无权直接作出判决。

❌ 干扰项解析
  • 选项 A 错误
    理由：通知要求仅适用于被告“已出庭”的情况。
    如果被告曾出庭（例如提交过动议），那么在法官作出缺席判决前，必须至少提前7天通知被告。但本案中拳击手从未回应，属于“未出庭”，因此不需要通知。
  • 选项 C 错误
    理由：未出庭只是前提，不是充分条件。
    被告未出庭允许书记员进行第一步（记录缺席），但要进行第二步（作出判决），必须满足“固定数额”的要求。
  • 选项 D 错误
    理由：书记员不能盲目接受诉状金额。
    只有在金额是“固定数额”且有宣誓书佐证时，书记员才能依据诉状金额判决。对于侵权案件（Tort）的痛苦抚慰金等，书记员无权直接定损。
💡 考试技巧

在 MBE 考试中遇到 Default Judgment by Clerk 的题目时，立即寻找两个关键词：

  1. Sum Certain（是否为简单的算术计算？如欠款、违约金）。如果是侵权 (Tort) 或人身伤害，通常不是 Sum Certain。
  2. Appearance（被告是否露面？）。如果被告露面了，Clerk 绝对不能判，必须由 Judge 判，且需给被告通知。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A woman sued a landlord in an appropriate federal district court under a federal statute that prohibits landlords from discriminating against a potential tenant based on familial status. Her complaint included a request for $10,000. The woman claimed that the landlord denied her rental application because she had two young children. The woman also included a demand for a jury trial in her complaint. No law would have prohibited the woman from occupying the apartment.
Under the federal statute, the plaintiff has the burden to establish a prima facie case that the defendant unlawfully discriminated against the plaintiff. If the plaintiff meets this burden, then the defendant must provide a nondiscriminatory reason why the plaintiff was not selected as a tenant. If the defendant does so, the burden shifts back to the plaintiff to show that the defendant's purported reason was a mere pretext for discrimination.
At the end of the trial, the woman demanded that all factual issues be submitted to the jury. She also requested that the jury return its verdict with answers to specific questions relating to each of those issues. The landlord consented to this type of verdict.
The judge gave the jury a proper verdict form that asked the jury to answer the specific questions that the woman had requested and to determine which party should prevail. The jury returned a verdict in favor of the woman and awarded her $10,000 in damages. In its answers to the specific questions, the jury indicated that the woman had presented sufficient evidence that the landlord discriminated against her. It also found that the landlord had a nondiscriminatory reason for denying the woman's application and that this reason was not a pretext for discrimination.
Which action would be IMPROPER for the judge to take?

choices.A: Direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict.
choices.B: Enter a judgment in favor of the landlord.
choices.C: Enter a judgment in favor of the woman.
choices.D: Order a new trial.

questions.explanation:
General verdict with answers
(FRCP 49(b))
Answers consistent with
verdict		 Judge must enter judgment consistent with verdict & answers
Answers inconsistent with
verdict		 Judge must:
• order new trial
• direct jury to further consider its answers & verdict or
• disregard verdict & enter judgment consistent with answers
Answers inconsistent with
each other & verdict		 Judge must:
• order new trial or
• direct jury to further consider its answers & verdict

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A verdict is the jury's determination of factual issues in a case. There are three types of verdicts—general verdicts, special verdicts, and general verdicts with answers—and the judge has the discretion to choose which verdict to use. Here, the judge asked the jury to return a general verdict with answers when he instructed them to (1) find in favor of, and award damages to, a particular party and (2) answer specific questions on each factual issue.

If the jury's answers and verdict are consistent, the judge must enter a judgment consistent with those determinations. But when, as here, the jury's answers (no pretext for discrimination) and verdict (in favor of the woman) are inconsistent, the judge must:

• order a new trial
• direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict or
• disregard the jury's verdict and enter a judgment consistent with the answers provided.

This means that the judge cannot enter a judgment consistent with the jury's verdict and find in favor of the woman (Choices A, B & D).

📌 Educational Objective

A general verdict with answers requires that the jury decide which party should prevail and provide answers to questions on each factual issue. If the verdict and answers are inconsistent, the judge must (1) order a new trial, (2) direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict, or (3) enter a judgment consistent with the answers.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 49(b) (general verdict with answers).
questions.zh-question: 一名女性依据一项禁止房东因家庭状况歧视潜在租户的联邦法规，在一家适当的联邦地区法院对一名房东提起诉讼。她的诉状中包含了10,000美元的索赔请求。该女性声称，房东因为她有两个年幼的孩子而拒绝了她的租赁申请。该女性还在其诉状中要求进行陪审团审判。没有任何法律禁止该女性租住该公寓。 根据该联邦法规，原告负有举证责任，需建立一个被告对原告进行了非法歧视的初步证据成立的案件（prima facie case）。如果原告完成了此举证责任，则被告必须提供一个未选择原告为租户的无歧视性理由。如果被告这样做了，举证责任将转移回原告，由原告证明被告所声称的理由仅仅是歧视的借口。 审判结束时，该女性要求将所有事实问题提交给陪审团裁定。她还请求陪审团在作出裁决的同时，回答与每一项事实问题相关的具体问题。房东同意了这种类型的裁决。 法官向陪审团提供了一份适当的裁决表格，要求陪审团回答该女性所请求的具体问题，并决定哪一方应胜诉。陪审团作出了有利于该女性的裁决，并判给她10,000美元的损害赔偿金。在对具体问题的回答中，陪审团表明该女性已提出充分证据证明房东歧视了她。陪审团还认定，房东拒绝该女性的申请有无歧视性的理由，并且该理由并非歧视的借口。 法官采取以下哪项行动是不适当的？

zh-choices.A: 指示陪审团进一步考虑其回答和裁决。
zh-choices.B: 作出有利于房东的判决。
zh-choices.C: 作出有利于该女性的判决。
zh-choices.D: 命令进行新的审判。

questions.zh-explanation:
民事诉讼法考点解析

Verdict and Judgment
核心考点： 当陪审团的“一般裁决”(General Verdict) 与其对“具体问题”(Written Questions) 的回答不一致时，法官该如何处理？

本题考察的是 Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 49(b)，即“附带书面问题回答的一般裁决”（General Verdict with Answers to Written Questions）。

一般裁决 (General Verdict)
判决原告胜诉 ($10,000)
VS
具体回答 (Written Answers)
认定理由非借口 (Not Pretext)
= 被告无责

矛盾点： 具体事实认定显示被告没有违法，但裁决结果却判被告输了。

⚖️ 法律规则 (FRCP 49(b)(3)) 当回答之间一致，但回答与一般裁决不一致时，法官有且仅有三种选择：
  1. 批准与回答一致的判决 (Enter judgment consistent with answers)：忽略一般裁决，根据具体事实认定判决（本案中即判房东胜诉）。
  2. 指示陪审团进一步考虑 (Direct the jury to further consider)：让陪审团回去重新商议，解决矛盾。
  3. 命令重审 (Order a new trial)。

为什么选项 C 是正确答案？

题目问的是哪项行动是不适当 (IMPROPER) 的。

不适当 选项 C (作出有利于该女性的判决):
这是法官绝对不能做的事情。因为陪审团对具体事实的认定（Specific Findings）在逻辑上优于一般裁决（General Verdict）。

在本案中，陪审团认定房东的理由不是借口 (Not Pretext)。根据法律，这意味着歧视不成立，房东不应承担责任。法官不能无视这一关键的事实认定而强行维持一个与之矛盾的胜诉裁决。
适当 选项 A (让陪审团再考虑):
这是规则允许的补救措施之一，试图让陪审团自己修正矛盾。
适当 选项 B (判房东胜诉):
这是规则允许的。法官可以依据“具体回答”（认定无歧视）直接作出判决，从而推翻错误的一般裁决。
适当 选项 D (重审):
如果矛盾无法解决，或者法官认为陪审团已经困惑，重审是标准的补救措施。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 中遇到 Verdict 题目：
  • 首先区分是 Special Verdict (FRCP 49(a)) 还是 General Verdict with Answers (FRCP 49(b))。
  • 如果是 49(b)，记住：具体回答 > 一般裁决。
  • 如果二者冲突，法官可以依据“具体回答”改判，但绝不能依据“一般裁决”无视具体事实。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A partnership registered in State A sued a former employee domiciled in State A in a federal court in State A. The partnership claimed that the employee breached the noncompete provision of her contract, which resulted in a $100,000 loss in revenue for the partnership. The partnership's members are all domiciled in State B.
The summons and complaint were served at the employee's apartment, where the process server handed the documents to the employee's 17-year-old roommate. The roommate neglected to give the documents to the employee, so the employee did not file an answer or any other response.
Thirty days later, the partnership asked the court clerk to enter the employee's default, and the clerk did so. The partnership then applied to the court for the entry of a default judgment. Upon receiving notice of the default-judgment hearing, the employee filed a motion to set aside the entry of default. In the motion, the employee argued that the noncompete provision was invalid.
If the court grants the employee's motion, what is the most likely explanation?

choices.A: The clerk erred by entering the employee's default.
choices.B: The court lacks subject-matter jurisdiction over the case because the parties are not diverse.
choices.C: The employee provided good cause for failing to timely respond.
choices.D: The employee was improperly served with process because the process server delivered process to the employee's roommate.

questions.explanation:
A default occurs when a defendant fails to timely serve an answer, which is generally due within 21 days after the defendant is served with process.* When the plaintiff shows this failure to the court clerk, the clerk must enter the defendant's default into the record of the case (as the clerk did here) (Choice A). However, a federal court can set aside an entry of default for good cause, which exists when:

  • the defendant's failure to timely respond was the result of excusable neglect
  • the defendant presented a meritorious defense and
  • the plaintiff would not be substantially prejudiced if the case is reopened.

Here, the employee's failure to timely respond was the result of excusable neglect because the roommate did not give the employee the summons and complaint. The employee then presented a meritorious defense by arguing that the noncompete provision was invalid. Reopening the case would not substantially prejudice the partnership since it can still pursue its claim. Therefore, if the court grants the employee's motion to set aside the entry of default, the most likely explanation is that the employee provided good cause for failing to timely respond.

*If the defendant files a pre-answer FRCP 12 motion, the defendant must serve an answer within 14 days after notice of the court's denial of the motion. A default occurs if the defendant fails to serve an answer by this deadline.

(Choice B) The court does have subject-matter jurisdiction based in diversity. The amount in controversy is $100,000 (exceeds $75,000), and the parties are citizens of different states (ie, diverse) because the employee is domiciled in State A and the partnership's members are domiciled in State B.

(Choice D) A defendant-individual in the U.S. can be properly served with process by leaving the summons and complaint at the defendant's dwelling with a resident of suitable age and discretion—eg, the employee's 17-year-old roommate.

📌 Educational Objective

A federal court may set aside an entry of default for good cause, which exists when (1) the failure to timely respond was the result of the defendant's excusable neglect, (2) the defendant presented a meritorious defense, and (3) the plaintiff would not be substantially prejudiced if the case is reopened.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 55(c) (setting aside a default or a default judgment).
  • 10A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2696 (4th ed. 2020) (explaining when a federal court will set aside an entry of default).
questions.zh-question:
一家在A州注册的合伙企业，在A州的联邦法院起诉了一名定居在A州的前雇员。该合伙企业声称，该雇员违反了其合同中的竞业禁止条款，导致合伙企业损失了10万美元的收入。该合伙企业的所有成员均定居在B州。

传票和诉状在该雇员的公寓送达，送达人将文件交给了该雇员17岁的室友。该室友疏忽了，未将文件交给该雇员，因此该雇员未提交答辩状或任何其他回应。

三十天后，该合伙企业请求法院书记员记录该雇员的缺席，书记员照办了。随后，该合伙企业向法院申请作出缺席判决。在收到缺席判决听证会的通知后，该雇员提起动议，请求撤销缺席记录。在动议中，该雇员主张竞业禁止条款无效。

如果法院批准了该雇员的动议，最可能的解释是什么？

zh-choices.A: 书记员在记录该雇员的缺席时犯了错误。
zh-choices.B: 法院对本案缺乏标的物管辖权，因为当事人不符合多元化管辖权的要求。
zh-choices.C: 该雇员为其未能及时回应提供了正当理由。
zh-choices.D: 对该雇员的诉讼文书送达不当，因为送达人将文书送达给了该雇员的室友。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：撤销缺席记录

本题考查的核心知识点是联邦民事诉讼中关于撤销缺席记录（Setting Aside an Entry of Default）的标准。

1. 核心法律规则 (FRCP 55(c))

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第55(c)条，法院可以因“正当理由”（Good Cause）撤销书记员做出的缺席记录（Entry of Default）。

在司法实践中，判断是否存在“正当理由”通常考虑以下三个因素：

  • 可原谅的疏忽 (Excusable Neglect)： 被告未能及时回应是否由其无法完全控制的疏忽导致？
  • 有胜诉可能的抗辩 (Meritorious Defense)： 被告是否提出了如果被证实，可以赢得诉讼的法律抗辩？
  • 对原告的损害 (Prejudice to Plaintiff)： 重新审理案件是否会对原告造成实质性的不公（不仅仅是延迟）？

2. 案情分析与正确答案逻辑

本题中，法院批准撤销缺席记录的最可能原因是选项 C。

分析 疏忽是可原谅的： 传票送达给了17岁的室友，室友忘记转交。这并非被告故意无视法庭程序（Willful default），属于典型的“可原谅的疏忽”。
分析 存在有效抗辩： 被告主张竞业禁止条款（Noncompete provision）无效。如果该主张成立，被告将胜诉，这构成了Meritorious Defense。
结论 由于满足了撤销缺席记录的“正当理由”标准，法院倾向于根据案情实质解决争议，而非通过技术性的缺席判决结案。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A 错误（书记员无误）：
当被告未在规定时间（通常为21天）内回应时，只要原告提出申请并附带证明，书记员必须记录缺席。书记员的操作符合程序。
选项 B 错误（管辖权存在）：
本题涉及合伙企业公民身份规则（Partnership Citizenship）。合伙企业的公民身份取决于其每一位合伙人的住所地。
  • 原告：所有合伙人都在B州 → 原告视为B州公民。
  • 被告：A州公民。
双方完全多元（Complete Diversity），且金额 > $75k，因此法院拥有标的物管辖权（Subject-matter Jurisdiction）。
选项 D 错误（送达有效）：
根据 FRCP 4(e)(2)(B)，将文书留在被告住所，交给一位居住在其中的、具有适当年龄和判断力（Suitable age and discretion）的人即为有效送达。通常认为17岁室友符合此标准。室友是否转交不影响送达的法律效力。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

区分两个概念：

  1. 缺席记录 (Entry of Default)： 由书记员操作，仅表示被告未回应。
  2. 缺席判决 (Default Judgment)： 由法院（或特定情况下的书记员）做出的最终判决。

撤销“缺席记录”的标准（Good Cause）比撤销“缺席判决”的标准（FRCP 60(b) excusable neglect）要宽松一些。法院通常倾向于撤销缺席，以便让案件在实体上得到审理。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
An individual investor purchased stock through a company's stock offering. When the price of the stock plummeted, the investor sued the company in a state court in State A, claiming that the company's offering materials had fraudulently induced him to purchase the stock and seeking $25,000 in damages.
A university that had purchased the company's stock through the same offering sued the company in federal court in State B, claiming that the offering materials violated federal securities laws and seeking $1 million in damages.
The individual investor's suit proceeded to trial. The state court ruled that the company's offering materials contained false information and awarded the investor a $25,000 judgment. The university immediately moved for partial summary judgment in its federal action against the company, arguing that the state court judgment bound the federal court on the issue of whether the company's offering materials contained false information.
Neither State A nor State B permits nonmutual issue preclusion.
Should the court grant the university's motion?

choices.A: No, because State A does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion.
choices.B: No, because the federal court sits in a state that does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion.
choices.C: Yes, because federal law permits nonmutual issue preclusion.
choices.D: Yes, because the issue of whether the materials contained false information was actually litigated and necessarily decided.

Issue preclusion (ie, collateral estoppel) precludes subsequent litigation of the same issue actually litigated, determined, and necessary to a valid final judgment issued on an earlier claim. There are two types of issue preclusion:

  • Mutual – issue preclusion in second action asserted by parties to the first action against other parties to the first action
  • Nonmutual – issue preclusion in second action asserted by nonparties to the first action against parties to the first action

The court will look to the court that entered the first judgment to determine which issue-preclusion rule applies to the second action. A judgment entered by a federal court means federal preclusion law applies,* while a judgment entered by a state court means state's preclusion law applies.

Here, the state court in State A entered the first judgment, so State A's preclusion law applies to the second action in federal court. State A does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion. As a result, the university (a nonparty to the first action) cannot argue that the state court judgment bound the federal court on the same issue. The federal court should therefore deny the university's motion for partial summary judgment.

*A federal court sitting in diversity will generally apply the preclusion law of the state in which it sits unless the state law is incompatible with federal interests.

(Choice B) A judgment's preclusive effect is determined by the law of the forum that entered the judgment (here, State A)—not the forum where the second court sits (here, State B).

(Choice C) Although federal law permits nonmutual issue preclusion, the State A law prohibiting nonmutual issue preclusion applies.

(Choice D) The issue of whether the company's materials contained false information was actually litigated and necessarily decided in the first action. But since State A does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion, the university cannot assert it in the second action.

📌 Educational Objective

Issue preclusion can be asserted by parties to the first action (mutual) OR by nonparties to the first action (nonmutual) against parties to the first action. If the first action was decided by a state court, then that state's issue-preclusion rule applies.

📚 References
  • 28 U.S.C. § 1738 (full faith and credit statute).
  • Allen v. McCurry, 449 U.S. 90, 96 (1980) (stating that federal courts must give the same preclusive effect to state court judgments that courts in the judgment-rendering state would apply).
  • 47 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 549 (2020) (explaining mutual and nonmutual estoppel).
questions.zh-question:
一名个人投资者通过一家公司的股票发行购买了股票。当股价暴跌时，该投资者在A州的州法院起诉该公司，声称公司的发行材料欺诈性地诱使其购买股票，并寻求25,000美元的损害赔偿。

一所大学通过同一次发行购买了该公司的股票，并在B州的联邦法院起诉该公司，声称发行材料违反了联邦证券法，并寻求100万美元的损害赔偿。

个人投资者的诉讼进入了审判程序。州法院裁定，该公司的发行材料包含虚假信息，并判给投资者25,000美元的赔偿。该大学立即在其对该公司的联邦诉讼中提出部分即决判决动议，主张州法院的判决在公司发行材料是否包含虚假信息这一争点上对联邦法院具有约束力。

A州和B州均不允许非互惠争点排除。

法院是否应批准该大学的动议？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为A州不允许非互惠争点排除。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为该联邦法院所在的州不允许非互惠争点排除。
zh-choices.C: 应该，因为联邦法律允许非互惠争点排除。
zh-choices.D: 应该，因为关于材料是否包含虚假信息的争点已经过实际诉讼且为判决所必需。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Preclusion (判决效力)
⚖️ 核心法则：全格信赖与信用 (Full Faith and Credit)

根据 28 U.S.C. § 1738，联邦法院必须给予州法院判决与该州法院自身相同的既判力（Preclusive Effect）。

即：判决作出地法律 (Law of the Rendering Court) 决定判决的效力。

本题考察的是争点排除 (Issue Preclusion / Collateral Estoppel) 在跨辖区诉讼中的适用规则。正确答案是 A。

1
识别第一次判决的来源
第一个判决（Judgment 1）是由 A 州 (State A) 的州法院作出的。
2
确定作出判决法院的法律规则
根据题目事实，A 州法律不允许 (does not permit) 非互惠争点排除（Nonmutual Issue Preclusion）。

Nonmutual Offensive 这意味着，如果原告（大学）不是第一次诉讼的当事人，它不能利用第一次诉讼的判决来攻击被告（公司）。
3
联邦法院的义务
尽管第二次诉讼是在联邦法院（B州）进行，且涉及联邦证券法，但根据最高法院判例 Allen v. McCurry，联邦法院在判断先前州法院判决的效力时，必须遵循该州的规则。

既然 A 州法院自己都不会允许这所大学利用该判决进行争点排除，那么联邦法院也不能允许。
⚠️ 常见思维陷阱 (Exam Traps)

陷阱 1：Erie Doctrine 的误用 (选项 B)
考生常误以为联邦法院应适用“所在地” (State B) 的法律。但在既判力问题上，适用的是作出判决的法院 (Rendering Court) 的法律，而不是当前法院 (Forum Court) 的法律。

陷阱 2：联邦普通法优先 (选项 C)
虽然联邦普通法通常允许非互惠争点排除，但当先前的判决来自州法院时，联邦法院受《全格信赖与信用法案》约束，必须尊重该州的限制。

陷阱 3：只看要素 (选项 D)
虽然争点确实被“实际诉讼并裁决”了，但如果法律本身禁止非当事人使用该判决（即禁止 Nonmutual），那么满足其他要素也无济于事。

总结：
State Court Judgment → Federal Court Action
Look to State Law for Preclusion Rules.

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A writer and a publisher entered into a contract in which the publisher agreed to pay the writer royalties from the sale of her book at a set percentage. At the end of the first year of the contract, the writer received a royalty check for an amount that she believed was lower than agreed.
The writer sued the publisher in state court for breach of contract. The writer claimed that the contract set the royalty percentage at 7%. However, the publisher claimed that the contract only required 4% royalties due to a condition precedent. The jury returned a verdict in favor of the writer, and the court entered a judgment consistent with the verdict.
At the end of the second year of the contract, the writer received another royalty check for an amount she again believed was low. She sued the publisher in a federal court for breaching the same contractual provision. The publisher has asserted the defense of claim preclusion (res judicata) in its answer.
Is the federal court likely to give preclusive effect to the state court judgment?

choices.A: No, because the judgment was entered by a state court.
choices.B: No, because the second action involves a different claim.
choices.C: Yes, because both actions involve identical claims between the same parties.
choices.D: Yes, because the first action was actually litigated.

questions.explanation:
Claim-preclusion requirements
Valid final judgment on the merits
  • Made in consideration of substantive (not technical)
    grounds of claim or defense
  • Leaves nothing for court to do but enforce judgment
↓
Identical claims
  • Claims arose from same transaction,
    occurrence, or series thereof
  • Both claims could have been raised in first action
↓
Identical parties
  • Involves same parties or those in privity
  • Parties occupy same role in both actions*
*Parties need not occupy the same role if a party violates the first court's compulsory counterclaim rule.
Under the doctrine of claim preclusion (ie, res judicata), a valid final judgment on the merits precludes identical parties from relitigating identical claims. Claims are identical if they (1) arise from the same transaction, occurrence, or series thereof and (2) could have been raised in the first action. To determine whether claims arise from the same transaction or occurrence, courts consider the following factors:
  • whether the facts are related in time, space, origin, or motivation
  • whether the facts form a convenient trial unit and
  • whether treatment of the facts as a unit conforms to the parties' expectations or business usage.
Here, the state court entered a final judgment in favor of the writer for the publisher's year-one breach of the contract. The writer then sued the publisher in federal court for the publisher's year-two breach. Although both claims arise from the same contractual provision, the writer's claim for her year-two royalties did not exist at the time of the first action. Therefore, the claims are not identical, and the federal court is unlikely to give preclusive effect to the state court judgment (Choice C).

(Choice A) The fact that a state court entered the judgment in the first action is irrelevant because all courts must give full faith and credit to state court judgments.

(Choice D) Claim preclusion applies even if the first action was not actually litigated (eg, when a default judgment was entered). In contrast, the related doctrine of issue preclusion (ie, collateral estoppel) applies only when issues that were actually litigated, determined, and essential to a valid final judgment are raised in a subsequent action.

📌 Educational Objective

Claim preclusion (ie, res judicata) provides that a valid final judgment on the merits precludes identical parties from relitigating identical claims. Claims are identical if they (1) arise from the same transaction, occurrence, or series thereof and (2) could have been raised in the first action.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Judgments § 24 (Am. Law Inst. 1982) (defining identical claims).
  • Lawlor v. Nat'l Screen Serv. Corp., 349 U.S. 322, 327–28 (1955) (holding that claim preclusion only applies to claims that existed at the time of the first action).
questions.zh-question:
一位作家和一家出版商签订了一份合同，其中出版商同意按设定的百分比向作家支付其书籍销售的版税。在合同第一年年底，作家收到一张版税支票，她认为金额低于约定数额。

作家以违约为由在州法院起诉了该出版商。作家声称合同规定的版税率为7%。然而，出版商声称，由于存在先决条件，合同仅要求支付4%的版税。陪审团作出了有利于作家的裁决，法院也据此作出了判决。

在合同第二年年底，作家又收到一张版税支票，她再次认为金额过低。她以违反同一合同条款为由，在联邦法院起诉了该出版商。出版商在其答辩中主张了请求权排除（res judicata）的抗辩。

联邦法院是否可能赋予州法院判决以排除效力？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为判决是由州法院作出的。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为第二次诉讼涉及不同的请求权。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为两次诉讼涉及相同当事人之间的相同请求权。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为第一次诉讼经过了实际的诉讼程序。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析

Civil Procedure | Claim Preclusion
正确答案 选项 B

"No, because the second action involves a different claim."
（不会，因为第二次诉讼涉及不同的请求权。）

核心考点：请求权排除

本题考察的是请求权排除（Claim Preclusion，又称 Res Judicata）的适用范围，特别是针对分期履行合同（Installment Contracts）或持续性义务的违约认定。

规则三要素：
请求权排除要生效，必须满足以下三个条件：

  1. 相同当事人（Same Parties）：原被告相同或具有利害关系（Privity）。
  2. 有效终局判决（Valid Final Judgment on the Merits）。
  3. 相同请求权（Same Claim）：源于同一交易或事件（Same Transaction or Occurrence）。
法律推理与逻辑

本题的关键在于判断第二次诉讼是否属于“相同请求权”。

1. 时间维度的切割：
虽然两次诉讼都源于同一份合同，甚至涉及同一个条款（版税率），但根据美国联邦法律原则（及大多数州法），请求权排除仅适用于在第一次诉讼提起时已经存在的请求权。

2. 新的违约 = 新的请求权：
作家第一次起诉时，仅针对第一年的版税违约。当时，第二年的违约尚未发生，作家不可能在第一次诉讼中主张第二年的权利。因此，第二年的违约构成了一个新的、独立的请求权（Separate Claim）。

3. 结论：
由于第二次诉讼涉及的是一个新的请求权（第二年的版税），不满足 Res Judicata 的第三个要素，因此联邦法院不会因前诉判决而驳回本案。

易混淆点：争点排除

考生常混淆请求权排除（Claim Preclusion）与争点排除（Issue Preclusion / Collateral Estoppel）。

  • 请求权排除：试图将整个案件“拒之门外”。本题中出版商试图用此抗辩直接驳回起诉，但失败了。
  • 争点排除：试图不再争论某个具体事实或法律问题。如果作家主张：“法院啊，第一年诉讼已经判定版税率是7%了，出版商不能再辩称是4%了”，这属于争点排除，这是可能会成功的。

但题目问的是出版商主张的 Res Judicata（即试图完全阻止作家起诉），这在法律上是不成立的。

为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A (State Court)：错误。根据《宪法》的充分信任和尊重条款（Full Faith and Credit Clause），联邦法院必须尊重州法院的判决。
  • 选项 C (Identical Claims)：错误。这是最大的干扰项。虽然合同条款相同，但违约发生在不同时间段。对于分期付款或周期性义务，随后的违约产生新的请求权。
  • 选项 D (Actually Litigated)：错误。“实际诉讼”是争点排除的要求，而非请求权排除的要求（请求权排除甚至适用于缺席判决）。且该选项未触及核心问题：请求权本身是不同的。
MBE 考试技巧 💡

在遇到“前诉判决是否阻止后诉”的题目时：

  1. 先看是Claim Preclusion（封杀整个案件）还是Issue Preclusion（封杀具体事实/法律点）。
  2. 如果是持续性合同（租金、版税、分期付款），记住口诀："You can't sue for tomorrow's breach today."（你不能为明天的违约在今天起诉）。
  3. 后发生的违约永远是新的 Claim。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A manufacturer sued a buyer in federal court for failing to make timely payments under the parties' sales contract. The case was tried to the court solely on documentary evidence. Immediately after the close of the evidence, the judge announced from the bench, "Judgment shall be entered for the manufacturer," and judgment was so entered. The buyer has appealed the judgment.
What is the buyer's best argument for persuading the appellate court to reverse the judgment?

choices.A: The judgment is clearly erroneous because it was based solely on documentary evidence.
choices.B: The manufacturer was required to file proposed findings and conclusions before the trial court ruled.
choices.C: The trial court erred because it announced the judgment without giving the parties an opportunity to submit proposed findings and conclusions.
choices.D: The trial court erred by not providing findings and conclusions.

questions.explanation:
Jury trial

Jury acts as finder of fact.
Judge acts as interpreter of law.

v.
Bench trial

Judge acts as finder of fact
and interpreter of law.

In a case tried to the court (ie, a bench trial), the judge serves as both the finder of fact and interpreter of the law. As a result, Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 52(a) requires that the judge provide factual findings and legal conclusions (orally or in writing) on the record after the close of evidence. This allows the parties and the appellate court to have a clear understanding of the judge's reasoning. If a judge fails to provide these required findings and conclusions, the appellate court should reverse the trial court's judgment.

In this bench trial, the judge announced, "Judgment shall be entered for the manufacturer," immediately after the close of evidence. However, the judge failed to provide the required factual findings and legal conclusions. As a result, that is the buyer's best argument to persuade the appellate court to reverse the judgment.

(Choice A) Factual findings in a bench trial will only be reversed on appeal if they were clearly erroneous because no reasonable judge would have made them. However, a judgment based solely on documentary evidence is not clearly erroneous. That is because such evidence can provide strong support for the judge's findings—especially in a breach-of-contract case (as seen here).

(Choices B & C) The parties are not required to file proposed findings and conclusions but may do so if the trial court allows. Additionally, a trial court does not need to give the parties an opportunity to submit proposed findings and conclusions.

📌 Educational Objective

In a bench trial, the judge must provide factual findings and legal conclusions on the record (orally or in writing) after the close of evidence. Failure to do so will result in a reversal of the judgment on appeal.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(a) (findings of fact and conclusions of law).
questions.zh-question:
一家制造商因买方未能根据双方的销售合同按时付款，在联邦法院对其提起诉讼。该案仅根据书面证据由法官进行审理。证据呈示结束后，法官立即当庭宣布：“应判决制造商胜诉”，判决也如此作出。买方已对该判决提起上诉。

买方说服上诉法院推翻该判决的最佳论点是什么？

zh-choices.A: 该判决是明显错误的，因为它仅基于书面证据。
zh-choices.B: 在审判法院作出裁决之前，制造商被要求提交拟议的事实认定和法律结论。
zh-choices.C: 审判法院犯了错误，因为它在未给予双方提交拟议的事实认定和法律结论的机会的情况下就宣布了判决。
zh-choices.D: 审判法院因未提供事实认定和法律结论而犯了错误。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Bench Trials & Findings

⚖️ 核心法律规则
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 52(a)
(Findings and Conclusions by the Court)

在法官审判 (Bench Trial) 中，即没有陪审团的审判，法官身兼两职：

Finder of Fact
(事实认定者)
替代陪审团
Interpreter of Law
(法律适用者)
法官本职

因此，FRCP 52(a) 强制要求法官在作出判决时，必须在记录中（口头或书面）明确说明：

  1. Findings of Fact (事实认定)
  2. Conclusions of Law (法律结论)

目的： 让上诉法院 (Appellate Court) 能够理解法官的判决逻辑，从而进行有效的审查。

🔍 题目分析与正确答案

案情回顾： 这是一个法官审判 (tried to the court)。证据呈示结束后，法官直接宣布“判决制造商胜诉”，除此之外什么都没说。

✅ 正确答案：D

理由： 审判法院犯了程序性错误，因为未提供事实认定和法律结论。

仅仅宣布“谁赢了”是不够的。根据 FRCP 52(a)，法官必须解释为什么赢（基于哪些事实，适用了什么法律）。没有这些记录，上诉法院无法履行其审查职能，因此这是推翻判决 (Reverse/Remand) 的最佳理由。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A (错误)：关于书面证据

解析： 案件仅基于书面证据 (Documentary Evidence) 审理并不是错误的理由。法官完全可以依据书面材料进行事实认定。除非该认定是“明显错误” (Clearly Erroneous) 的，否则上诉法院不会推翻。但本题的问题在于法官根本没有给出认定，而不是认定本身错了。

选项 B & C (错误)：关于拟议认定 (Proposed Findings)

解析： 虽然当事人可以提交拟议的事实认定和法律结论，但这并非强制性要求 (unless ordered by court)，法院也不必非要给当事人机会提交后才能判决。关键错误在于法官自己没有做这件事，而不是当事人有没有做。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

看到 "Tried to the court" 或 "Bench trial" 时，立即联想以下考点：

  • 法官必须分别陈述 Findings of Fact 和 Conclusions of Law。
  • 上诉审查标准 (Standard of Review)：
    • 法律问题 (Law) ➡️ De Novo (重新审视)
    • 事实问题 (Fact) ➡️ Clearly Erroneous (明显错误)

questions.question:
An investor sued a company's chief executive officer (CEO) for federal securities fraud in a federal court. The investor properly served process on the CEO, but the CEO did not file an answer or any other response.
Thirty days after service of process, the investor asked the clerk of the court to enter the CEO's default, which the clerk promptly did. The investor then submitted to the clerk a request for default judgment that included an affidavit stating that the CEO defrauded her of $100,000. The clerk entered a default judgment for this amount. Twenty days later, the CEO learned of the default judgment and immediately filed a motion to set it aside because he was abroad when the default judgment was entered.
How will the court likely rule on the CEO's motion?

choices.A: Deny the motion, because a court may not set aside an entry of a default judgment.
choices.B: Deny the motion, because the clerk properly entered the default judgment.
choices.C: Grant the motion, because only a judge may enter a default judgment.
choices.D: Grant the motion, because the CEO was not notified of the request for default judgment.

A default refers to a defendant's failure to timely serve an answer to a lawsuit, which is generally due within 21 days after the defendant is served with process. When the plaintiff shows this failure to the court clerk, the clerk must enter the defendant's default into the record of the case (as seen here). The default can then be entered as a default judgment by the clerk or the court (Choice C). The clerk must enter a default judgment when:

  • the plaintiff's claim is for a sum certain—ie, a specified or set amount—or a sum that can be made certain by calculation
  • the plaintiff's request for default judgment includes an affidavit establishing the amount due
  • the defendant failed to appear—ie, did not file a motion or otherwise act before the court—and
  • the defendant is not legally incompetent or a minor.

Here, the investor filed an affidavit that claimed the CEO defrauded her of $100,000—a sum certain. And since the CEO failed to appear and is not legally incompetent or a minor, the clerk properly entered a default judgment. Therefore, the court will likely deny the CEO's motion to set aside the default judgment.

(Choice A) A court may set aside the clerk's entry of default for good cause. And a court may set aside a default judgment for any reason justifying relief from a final judgment—none of which apply here.

(Choice B) Deny the motion, because the clerk properly entered the default judgment.

(Choice D) If the defendant previously appeared before the court, the plaintiff must serve the defendant with written notice of the application for default judgment seven days before a hearing on the matter. But here, the CEO failed to appear, so no such notice was required.

📌 Educational Objective

A court clerk must enter a default judgment when (1) the plaintiff's claim is for a sum certain, (2) the plaintiff's request for default judgment includes an affidavit establishing the amount due, (3) the defendant failed to appear, and (4) the defendant is not legally incompetent or a minor.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 55 (default judgments).
questions.zh-question:
一名投资者在联邦法院以联邦证券欺诈为由，起诉了一家公司的首席执行官（CEO）。该投资者向CEO进行了适当的送达，但CEO未提交答辩状或任何其他回应。

在送达30天后，投资者请求法院书记官记录CEO的缺席，书记官迅速照办。随后，投资者向书记官提交了一份缺席判决请求，其中包含一份宣誓书，声明CEO骗取了她10万美元。书记官据此金额作出了缺席判决。二十天后，CEO得知该缺席判决，并立即提出动议请求撤销该判决，理由是缺席判决作出时他身在国外。

法院将可能如何裁定CEO的动议？

zh-choices.A: 驳回动议，因为法院不得撤销已作出的缺席判决。
zh-choices.B: 驳回动议，因为书记官作出缺席判决的程序是适当的。
zh-choices.C: 批准动议，因为只有法官才能作出缺席判决。
zh-choices.D: 批准动议，因为CEO未被告知有关缺席判决的请求。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析

Civil Procedure: Default Judgment
正确答案：B 法院将驳回动议，因为书记官作出缺席判决的程序是适当的。
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRCP 55)
本题考查的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第55条关于缺席判决 (Default Judgment) 的作出程序。

在联邦法院，缺席判决的作出分为两步：
  1. 记录缺席 (Entry of Default)：由书记官 (Clerk) 记录。
  2. 作出缺席判决 (Entry of Default Judgment)：由书记官或法官作出。
书记官必须作出判决的 4 个条件：
根据 FRCP 55(b)(1)，如果满足以下所有条件，书记官 (Clerk) 必须应原告请求作出缺席判决，而无需法官介入：
  • ✅ 确定金额 (Sum Certain)：索赔金额是固定的，或可通过简单计算得出。
  • ✅ 宣誓书 (Affidavit)：原告提交了证明欠款金额的宣誓书。
  • ✅ 未出庭 (Failed to Appear)：被告从未在法庭上有任何形式的应诉或露面。
  • ✅ 被告身份适格：被告不是未成年人或无行为能力人。
🔍 案情应用
在本案中，书记官的行为完全符合法律规定：
  • 金额确定：投资者索赔 $100,000，这是一个具体的数字 (Sum Certain)。
  • 文件齐全：投资者提交了宣誓书。
  • 被告状态：CEO 完全没有回应 (Did not file an answer)，也没有出庭 (Failed to appear)。

虽然 CEO 提出他在国外，但这并不自动构成撤销判决的理由（除非他能证明送达不当或有“可原谅的疏忽”等 Rule 60(b) 的理由）。题目问的是法院“可能”如何裁决，由于书记官的程序完全合法，且 CEO 仅仅以“在国外”为由（且已知送达是适当的），法院最可能维持该判决。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误
选项 A 错误 法院有权撤销缺席判决。根据 FRCP 60(b)，如果有正当理由（如欺诈、错误、可原谅的疏忽等），法院可以撤销终局判决。选项 A 说法太绝对。
选项 C 错误 并非只有法官才能作出缺席判决。如上所述，对于确定金额 (Sum Certain) 的案件，书记官有权直接作出判决。
选项 D 错误 通知要求 (Notice Requirement) 仅适用于被告已经出庭 (Appeared) 的情况。如果被告曾出庭（例如提交过动议但后来消失），原告必须在听证会前至少 7 天通知被告。本案中 CEO 从未出庭，因此不需要通知。
💡 MBE 解题技巧 遇到 Default Judgment 的题目，首先判断：
1. 是谁作出的判决？ (Clerk vs. Judge)
2. 金额是否确定？ (Sum Certain vs. Damages to be determined)
3. 被告是否出过庭？ (Appeared vs. Failed to appear)

记住口诀："Clerk acts on Sum Certain + No Appearance." (书记官处理确定金额且未出庭的案件)。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff filed a tort action in state court but then failed to prosecute the action. The defendant moved to dismiss the action, and the court granted the motion in an order that stated: "The defendant's motion to dismiss is granted, and this action is dismissed with prejudice." The court accordingly entered judgment for the defendant.
The plaintiff then filed the same claim against the defendant in federal court, invoking diversity jurisdiction. The defendant has asserted the defense of res judicata (claim preclusion) in its answer.
Should the federal court give preclusive effect to the state court judgment?

choices.A: No, because the judgment was entered by a state court, not a federal court.
choices.B: No, because the state court did not rule on the merits in its dismissal.
choices.C: Yes, because a dismissal with prejudice operates as a judgment on the merits.
choices.D: Yes, because a judgment for failure to prosecute operates as a judgment on the merits under the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.

questions.explanation:
Choice of law for preclusion

State court
→
2nd action

Federal court

Apply federal preclusion law*
*Federal court sitting in diversity will likely apply
the law of the state where it sits

The doctrine of res judicata (ie, claim preclusion) provides that a valid final judgment on the merits precludes a party from relitigating an identical claim against the same party—regardless of whether the actions were filed in state or federal court (Choice A). However, the court in which the judgment was entered determines which claim-preclusion rule applies:

  • A judgment entered in state court means that state’s law applies to the second action.
  • A judgment entered in federal court means federal law applies to the second action.

(Choice B) Here, the plaintiff's first tort action was dismissed with prejudice by the state court. A dismissal with prejudice constitutes a final judgment on the merits, so the federal court must give preclusive effect to the state court judgment (Choice B). And since the judgment was entered by a state court, that state's rule on claim preclusion should apply.

(Choice D) Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 41(b), a dismissal for failure to prosecute a case in federal court operates as a judgment on the merits in that federal court. But since the state court rendered the judgment dismissing the plaintiff's claim, state claim-preclusion law (not the FRCP) applies.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the doctrine of res judicata (ie, claim preclusion), a valid final judgment on the merits precludes a party from relitigating an identical claim against the same party—regardless of whether the actions were filed in state or federal court.

📚 References
  • 28 U.S.C. § 1738 (full faith and credit statute).
  • Allen v. McCurry, 449 U.S. 90, 96 (1980) (stating that federal courts must give the same preclusive effect to state court judgments that courts in the judgment-rendering state would give).

原告在州法院提起侵权诉讼，但随后未能推进该诉讼。被告动议驳回该诉讼，法院批准了该动议，并在命令中声明：“被告的驳回动议已获批准，本诉讼被有偏见地驳回 (dismissed with prejudice)。” 法院因此作出了对被告有利的判决。

随后，原告援引多元管辖权，在联邦法院对同一被告提起了相同的诉讼请求。被告在其答辩中主张了既判力（诉讼请求排除）的抗辩。

联邦法院是否应给予州法院的判决以排除效力？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为该判决是由州法院而非联邦法院作出的。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为州法院的驳回裁定并未就案件实体问题作出裁决。
zh-choices.C: 应，因为有偏见的驳回具有实体判决的效力。
zh-choices.D: 应，因为根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》，因未能推进诉讼而作出的判决具有实体判决的效力。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Res Judicata
正确答案：C

本题考察的核心是既判力（Res Judicata / Claim Preclusion）以及联邦法院如何处理州法院的判决。

核心考点：有偏见的驳回 (Dismissal with Prejudice) 当法院将案件 "dismissed with prejudice" 时，这在法律上等同于实体判决 (Judgment on the Merits)。这意味着原告被永久禁止就同一诉因再次起诉。

⚖️ 法律推理逻辑

1. 既判力的三个要素
要适用既判力（Claim Preclusion），必须满足：
  • 相同的当事人 (Same Parties)
  • 相同的诉讼请求 (Same Claim)
  • 有效的实体终局判决 (Valid Final Judgment on the Merits)

本案中，前两个要素显然满足。争议点在于第三个要素：因“未能推进诉讼”而被“有偏见驳回”是否属于实体判决？答案是肯定的。
2. 充分信任和信用条款 (Full Faith and Credit)
根据 28 U.S.C. § 1738，联邦法院必须给予州法院判决与该州法院相同的效力。

既然州法院已经作出了“有偏见的驳回”（即实体终局判决），联邦法院必须尊重这一判决，禁止原告重新起诉。
⚠️ 易错点辨析：为什么不选 D？

选项 D 提到了《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP)。这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。

虽然 FRCP 41(b) 确实规定在联邦法院因未能起诉而被驳回视为实体判决，但本案的第一项判决是由州法院 (State Court) 作出的。

关键规则：

  • 如果是联邦法院的判决 → 适用联邦法律 (FRCP)。
  • 如果是州法院的判决 → 适用该州的既判力规则（通过 Full Faith and Credit Act）。

虽然结果相同（都是有既判力），但选项 D 的法律依据（FRCP）是错误的，因为 FRCP 不管辖州法院的判决效力。

其他选项分析
  • 选项 A 错误：既判力不分法院系统。联邦法院必须尊重州法院的判决。
  • 选项 B 错误："With prejudice"（有偏见）这个词本身就意味着法院已经对案件进行了终局性处理，具有实体判决的效力，即使法院没有开庭审理事实。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A gallery contracted with an owner of a painting to display the painting for five years, at which time the gallery agreed to return the painting to the owner. During the fifth year of the contract, the gallery agreed to loan the painting to a foreign businesswoman without obtaining the owner's permission. The businesswoman took the painting and has not been heard from since.
When the owner learned that the gallery no longer possessed the painting, the owner sued the gallery in federal court for breach of contract. At the conclusion of trial, the court entered judgment in favor of the owner for $100,000, the market value of the painting when the parties entered the contract.
The owner believed that the court should have awarded him $350,000, the market value of the painting when the contract ended. To recover this amount, the owner sued the gallery in federal court for conversion. The gallery has moved to dismiss this action on the basis of res judicata (claim preclusion).
Is the court likely to grant the gallery's motion?

choices.A: No.
choices.B: Yes, because the issue of whether the gallery failed to return the painting to the owner was actually litigated and necessarily decided.
choices.C: Yes, because the owner violated the election-of-remedies doctrine.
choices.D: Yes, because the owner's actions involve identical claims between the same parties.

questions.explanation:
Identical claims for claim preclusion

1st action
Breach-of-contract claim
related to owner's painting

Δ = defendant; π = plaintiff.

The doctrine of res judicata (ie, claim preclusion) provides that a valid final judgment on the merits precludes identical parties from relitigating identical claims. Claims are identical if they (1) arise from the same transaction, occurrence, or series thereof and (2) could have been raised in the first action because the claim existed and could have been joined. This is true even if the claims are labeled differently.

Here, the federal court in the first action entered a final judgment in the owner's favor for the gallery's breach of contract. The owner has now sued the gallery for conversion (identical parties). The breach of contract and conversion claims arise from the same transaction or occurrence because:

  • the facts are related in time, space, origin, and motivation (the gallery loaning the owner's painting to the businesswoman without the owner's permission)
  • the facts form a convenient trial unit (the same evidence applies to both claims) and
  • the treatment of the facts as a unit conforms to the parties' expectations (the parties were aware of these facts at the time of the first action).

The conversion claim existed at the time of the first action and could have been joined in that action, so the claims are identical. Therefore, the federal court in the second action is likely to grant the gallery's motion to dismiss based on res judicata ((Choice D)).*

*The first judgment was in favor of the owner (plaintiff), so the owner's conversion claim merges with the judgment and is extinguished. Had the judgment been in favor of the gallery (defendant), the owner's claim would be barred by the judgment and extinguished.

(Choice A) No.

(Choice B) Yes, because the issue of whether the gallery failed to return the painting to the owner was actually litigated and necessarily decided.

(Choice C) Yes, because the owner violated the election-of-remedies doctrine.

📌 Educational Objective

Under claim preclusion, a valid final judgment on the merits precludes identical parties from relitigating identical claims. Claims are identical if they (1) arise from the same transaction, occurrence, or series thereof and (2) could have been raised in the first action.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Judgments §§ 24–25 (Am. Law Inst. 1982) (defining identical claims for claim preclusion).

一家画廊与一幅画的所有者签订合同，约定将该画作展出五年，期满后画廊同意将画作归还给所有者。在合同的第五年，画廊未经所有者许可，同意将该画作出借给一位外国女商人。该女商人带走了画作，从此杳无音讯。

法院是否可能批准画廊的请求？

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Res Judicata

核心考点：既判力 (Claim Preclusion)

本题考察的是 Res Judicata（既判力），即 Claim Preclusion（诉讼标的排除/请求权阻断）。

规则定义：
如果法院已经对案件作出了有效的、终局的实体判决 (Valid final judgment on the merits)，则相同的当事人 (Same parties) 不得就同一诉讼标的 (Same claim) 再次提起诉讼。

联邦法院采用“交易法” (Transactional Approach) 来定义什么是“同一诉讼标的”：

只要新的诉讼请求源于与第一次诉讼相同的交易、事件或一系列事实 (Same transaction or occurrence)，无论原告更换了什么法律理论（如从违约变为侵权），都被视为“同一诉讼标的”。

本案分析

为什么法院会支持画廊的驳回请求（选 D）？

1
判决有效性：
第一次诉讼（违约之诉）已经结束，法院作出了实体判决。满足“有效终局判决”要件。
2
当事人相同：
两次诉讼的原告都是 Owner，被告都是 Gallery。满足“当事人相同”要件。
3
诉讼标的同一 (关键点)：
虽然第一次是“违约” (Contract)，第二次是“侵占” (Conversion)，但它们都源于同一个事实：画廊在第五年未经许可将画借给女商人导致丢失。

结论：由于侵占索赔在第一次诉讼时就已经存在，且源于同一事实，原告本应该在第一次诉讼中一并提出（可以主张备位请求）。因为他没有提，该请求权已被第一次判决吸收 (Merged) 并消灭。

易错陷阱辨析

选项 B 为什么错？（混淆概念）

选项 B 的措辞 "actually litigated and necessarily decided" 是 Issue Preclusion (Collateral Estoppel, 争点排除) 的标准，而不是 Claim Preclusion 的标准。

  • Claim Preclusion: 禁止重新起诉整个案件，即使某些问题在第一次没讨论过（只要它源于同一事实且本可以讨论）。
  • Issue Preclusion: 禁止重新争辩某个具体的事实或法律点（必须是实际争辩过且判决必须依赖该点的）。

本题是关于整个诉讼是否该被驳回，依据是 Claim Preclusion。

选项 C 为什么错？

Election of Remedies（救济选择原则）在联邦法院并不严格适用。联邦民事诉讼规则 (FRCP) 允许原告在起诉状中列出不一致的、替代性的法律理论（如：要么违约，要么侵权）。原告输掉官司不是因为他选了救济方式，而是因为他试图把一个案子拆成两次打。

正确答案：D
(涉及相同当事人之间的同一诉讼标的)

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
An accounting firm brought a federal diversity action against a former client for failing to pay for the firm's audit of the client's financial statements. After the client answered, the parties settled, and the court dismissed the action with prejudice. The client subsequently sued the firm for negligently performing the audit. The firm moved to dismiss the negligence action on the basis of res judicata (claim preclusion).
Is the court likely to grant the motion?

choices.A: No, because the firm's negligence was never raised or decided in the first action.
choices.B: No, because the first action was resolved by settlement.
choices.C: Yes, because the court dismissed the first action with prejudice.
choices.D: Yes, because the negligence claim was transactionally related to the claim in the first action and should have been asserted as a counterclaim.

questions.explanation:
Claim-preclusion requirements
Valid final judgment on the merits
  • Made in consideration of substantive (not technical)
    grounds of claim or defense
  • Leaves nothing for court to do but enforce judgment
↓
Identical claims
  • Claims arose from same transaction,
    occurrence, or series thereof
  • Both claims could have been raised in first action
↓
Identical parties
  • Involves same parties or those in privity
  • Parties occupy same role in both actions*
*Parties need not occupy the same role if a party violates the first court's compulsory counterclaim rule.

Res judicata (claim preclusion) provides that a valid final judgment on the merits precludes the relitigation of identical claims between identical parties. Parties are identical if they occupy the same roles in the first and subsequent actions—eg, the same party must be the plaintiff in both actions. But when the same parties occupy different roles (as seen here), claim preclusion will still apply if a party violated the first court's compulsory-counterclaim rule.

Here, the accounting firm brought the first action in federal court. Under FRCP 13, a counterclaim is compulsory (ie, must be asserted) if it:

  • arises from the same transaction or occurrence as the opposing party's claim and
  • does not require adding a party over whom the court cannot acquire jurisdiction.

The client's negligence claim against the accounting firm was transactionally related to the firm's claim in the first action since both concern the same audit. Since the client's claim does not require adding any parties, it should have been asserted as a counterclaim in the first action. By violating the compulsory-counterclaim rule, the client is precluded from asserting that claim in the second action. Therefore, the court in the second action will likely grant the firm's motion to dismiss based on res judicata.

(Choice A) Although the firm's negligence was never raised or decided in the first action, claim preclusion bars a claim that should have been asserted in a prior action (as seen here).

(Choice B) A judgment entered due to a settlement is entitled to claim-preclusive effect. However, such a judgment does not trigger issue preclusion, which requires actual litigation.

(Choice C) The fact that the first court dismissed the action with prejudice is insufficient by itself to trigger claim preclusion. That is because the claims in the first and second actions must also be transactionally related to trigger the compulsory-counterclaim rule.

📌 Educational Objective

Claim preclusion applies if the parties occupy the same roles in the first and subsequent actions—ie, the parties are identical. If the parties are not identical, claim preclusion will still apply if a party violated the first court's compulsory-counterclaim rule.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Judgments § 22 (Am. Law Inst. 1982) (explaining compulsory-counterclaim exception to identical-parties requirement).
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 13(a) (compulsory counterclaim).
questions.zh-question:
一家会计师事务所对一名前客户提起了联邦多元管辖权之诉，理由是该客户未能支付事务所对其财务报表的审计费用。在该客户作出答辩后，双方当事人达成和解，法院作出了不得再诉的驳回（dismissed with prejudice）。随后，该客户以该事务所在执行审计过程中存在过失为由起诉该事务所。该事务所基于“既判力（res judicata / 诉求排除）”原则，动议驳回该过失之诉。

法院是否可能批准该动议？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为该事务所的过失从未在第一次诉讼中被提出或裁决。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为第一次诉讼是通过和解解决的。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为法院对第一次诉讼作出了不得再诉的驳回。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为该过失诉求与第一次诉讼中的诉求在交易上相关，并且本应作为反诉提出。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Res Judicata
正确答案：选项 D 会，因为该过失诉求与第一次诉讼中的诉求在交易上相关，并且本应作为反诉提出。
核心逻辑：强制性反诉

本题虽然表面上问的是 Res Judicata（既判力/诉求排除），但解题的关键在于联邦民事诉讼规则中的强制性反诉规则 (Compulsory Counterclaim Rule)。

FRCP 13(a) 规定：
如果一项反诉源于对方诉求的同一交易或事件 (Same Transaction or Occurrence)，且不需要增加法院无法管辖的当事人，则该反诉必须在答辩中提出。

推理步骤：

  1. 同一交易：会计师事务所起诉“讨要审计费”，客户起诉“审计过失”。这两者都源于同一个核心事件——那次审计服务。因此，它们在交易上是相关的 (Transactionally Related)。
  2. 必须提出：客户在第一次诉讼中已经作出了答辩 (Answered)。此时，根据 FRCP 13(a)，客户必须提出基于同一交易的过失索赔作为反诉。
  3. 后果：客户没有提出反诉，案件随后以“不得再诉的驳回” (Dismissed with Prejudice) 结案。这相当于对案件实质作出了终局判决。
  4. 既判力适用：由于客户违反了强制性反诉规则，该诉求被视为已被放弃或已被裁决，因此在第二次诉讼中被 Res Judicata 禁止。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (未被提出)：
这是最常见的陷阱。既判力不仅排除已经实际裁决的诉求，也排除本应在第一次诉讼中提出但未提出的诉求（尤其是强制性反诉）。
选项 B (和解)：
和解并导致“不得再诉的驳回” (Dismissal with Prejudice) 在法律效力上等同于基于案情实质的终局判决 (Final Judgment on the Merits)。因此，它具有既判力效力。
选项 C (仅因驳回)：
这个选项理由不充分。仅仅因为第一次诉讼被驳回并不足以禁止第二次诉讼，关键在于第二次诉讼的诉求是否属于强制性反诉的范畴。如果第二次诉讼是关于完全无关的另一笔交易，即使第一次诉讼被驳回，第二次诉讼也可以进行。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

当你在题目中看到：

  • 第一次诉讼：A v. B (关于合同 X)
  • 第二次诉讼：B v. A (关于合同 X 的违约/过失)

请立即联想 FRCP 13(a) 强制性反诉。如果 B 在第一次诉讼中没有提反诉，B 就永远失去了起诉 A 的机会。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
In the first two weeks of a four-week bench trial in federal court, the plaintiff had called six witnesses to testify. Before the defense had an opportunity to call its own witnesses, the judge presiding over the case suddenly died from a heart attack.
How is the case likely to proceed?

choices.A: A new judge will take over, and the plaintiff's witnesses must testify again in the new judge's presence.
choices.B: A new judge will take over upon certifying familiarity with the record and determining that the case may be completed without prejudice.
choices.C: A new trial will be ordered.
choices.D: The case will be dismissed without prejudice.

questions.explanation:
Effect of judge's inability to proceed
(FRCP 63)

Was presiding judge unable to proceed
(eg, due to illness, emergency, death)?

│
Yes
↓

Did successor judge:

  • certify familiarity with record and
  • determine that completing case will not prejudice parties?
→ No → New trial required
Yes
↓
Successor judge
may take over

Hearing or bench trial

Witnesses must re-testify if:

  • testimony is material & disputed
  • no undue burden and
  • party so requested

Jury trial

Witnesses must re-testify if:

  • judge so orders
(Choice A) When the successor judge takes over a hearing or bench trial, witnesses who previously testified need only testify again in the successor judge's presence when (1) their testimony is material and disputed, (2) they can do so without undue burden, and (3) a party so requested. Therefore, the plaintiff's witnesses will only need to testify again if these requirements are satisfied—which cannot be determined under these facts (Choice A).
(Choice C) In the event a judge is incapacitated and cannot proceed, a new trial will be ordered only if the successor judge cannot certify familiarity with the record OR proceeding with the case will prejudice the parties (both of which are extremely rare).
(Choice D) When a case is dismissed without prejudice, the plaintiff may sue the defendant on the same claim in the future—ie, the dismissal is not an adjudication on the merits. However, a case will not be dismissed due to the incapacitation of the judge.
📌 Educational Objective

A successor judge may take over upon certifying familiarity with the record and determining that the case may be completed without prejudice to the parties. Otherwise, a new trial will be ordered.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 63 (judge's inability to proceed).
questions.zh-question:
在一个为期四周的联邦法院法官审理中，在前两周，原告已传唤六名证人作证。在被告方有机会传唤己方证人之前，该案的主审法官因心脏病发作突然去世。

该案件可能会如何进行？

zh-choices.A: 一名新法官将接管此案，原告的证人必须在新法官面前再次作证。
zh-choices.B: 一名新法官将在证明其熟悉卷宗并认定该案件可以在不损害当事人利益的情况下完成后接管此案。
zh-choices.C: 将裁定进行重新审理。
zh-choices.D: 该案件将在不损害再诉权的情况下被驳回。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure (民事诉讼法)

Topic: Verdict and Judgement

正确答案：B

本题考查的是当法官在审理过程中无法继续履职时，案件应如何进行的程序规则。

核心结论：继任法官在证明其熟悉卷宗并认定案件可以在不损害当事人利益的情况下完成后，可以接管案件。

法律依据：FRCP Rule 63

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第63条 (Fed. R. Civ. P. 63)，如果法官因死亡、疾病或其他残疾无法继续进行审理或听证，另一名法官 (Successor Judge) 可以接替，但必须满足以下两个条件：

  • 熟悉卷宗：继任法官必须证明其已熟悉案件记录 (certifying familiarity with the record)。
  • 无偏见/损害：继任法官必须认定，继续审理不会对当事人造成损害 (without prejudice to the parties)。

选项深度解析

为什么选 B？
选项 B 准确复述了 Rule 63 的核心要求。只要满足上述两个条件，审理就可以继续，而不需要直接宣布无效或重新审理。

为什么 A 错误？
选项 A 声称原告证人必须 (must) 再次作证，这过于绝对。
在非陪审团审理 (Bench Trial) 中，只有在以下情况同时满足时，继任法官才必须召回证人：

  1. 一方当事人提出请求；
  2. 证词是实质性的且存在争议 (material and disputed)；
  3. 证人可以再次作证且不会造成不当负担。
题目中并未说明这些条件已满足，因此不能断定必须重新作证。

为什么 C 错误？
重新审理 (New Trial) 是最后的手段。只有当继任法官无法熟悉卷宗，或者认为继续审理会对当事人造成无法补救的损害时，才会下令重新审理。

为什么 D 错误？
法官的去世属于程序性中断，并非对案件实体的裁决。法院不会因此驳回 (Dismiss) 案件，哪怕是“无偏见驳回”。

💡 备考小贴士

在 MBE 考试中遇到 "Judge's Inability to Proceed" 的考点时，请记住以下逻辑链条：

  1. 首选方案：换人 (Substitution)。只要能看懂卷宗且不坑害当事人，就由新法官接着干。
  2. 证人召回：不是自动的 (Not Automatic)。特别是在法官审理 (Bench Trial) 中，主要看证词是否关键且有争议 (Credibility matters)。
  3. 下策：只有换人行不通时，才重审 (New Trial)。

questions.question:
A man was charged in a state court in State A with involuntary manslaughter for causing the death of a pedestrian while driving under the influence of alcohol. The jury found the man guilty, and the court entered a judgment of conviction.
The pedestrian's family has now filed a wrongful death action against the man in a federal district court in State B. The family has moved for partial summary judgment, arguing that the state court judgment binds the federal court on the issues of whether the man breached his duty and caused the pedestrian's death.
State A permits nonmutual issue preclusion. However, State B prohibits nonmutual issue preclusion.
Should the federal court grant the family's motion?

choices.A: No, because the prior judgment was entered by a state court.
choices.B: No, because the state court action involved a criminal prosecution while the federal court action involves a civil claim.
choices.C: Yes, because the issues of whether the man breached his duty and caused the pedestrian's death were actually litigated and necessarily decided in the state court action.
choices.D: Yes, because the state court judgment is the law of the case.

Issue preclusion (ie, collateral estoppel) precludes the relitigation of issues that were actually litigated, determined, and necessary to a valid final judgment in a prior civil action or criminal prosecution (Choice B). There are two types of issue preclusion:

  • Mutual – when issue preclusion is asserted by parties to the first action against other parties to the first action
  • Nonmutual – when issue preclusion is asserted by nonparties to the first action against parties to the first action

To determine which preclusion rule applies, the second court will look to the law of the forum that entered the first judgment. Here, the State A state court entered judgment in the prior criminal prosecution, so the State B federal court should now apply State A's preclusion law in this wrongful death action. Since State A permits nonmutual issue preclusion, the family (nonparty to the first action) may assert issue preclusion against the man (party to the first action).

In the criminal prosecution, the jury found the man guilty of involuntary manslaughter—ie, an unintentional killing with criminal negligence. This means that the issues of whether the man breached a duty and caused the pedestrian's death were actually litigated and necessarily decided in the first action. Therefore, the federal court should grant the family's motion for partial summary judgment on these issues.*

*The family cannot obtain full summary judgment because it still must prove damages, which were not actually litigated or necessarily determined in the criminal prosecution.

(Choice A) A court must give full faith and credit to federal and state court judgments. Therefore, the fact that the prior judgment was entered by a state court is irrelevant.

(Choice D) The law-of-the-case doctrine prohibits the relitigation of legal issues decided at a previous stage of the same case. This doctrine does not apply here since the criminal prosecution and the wrongful death action are two different cases.

📌 Educational Objective

Issue preclusion bars the relitigation of issues that were actually litigated and necessarily determined by a valid final judgment in a prior civil action or criminal prosecution. The second court will look to the law of the forum that entered the first judgment to determine if mutual or nonmutual issue preclusion applies in the subsequent action.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Judgments § 85 (Am. Law Inst. 1982) (explaining the effect of a criminal judgment in a subsequent civil action).
  • 18B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 4474 (2d ed. 2020) (describing how nonparties to a criminal prosecution may assert issue preclusion against a party to the prosecution in a later civil action).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子因在酒精影响下驾驶导致一名行人死亡，而在A州的州法院被指控犯有非自愿过失杀人罪。陪审团裁定该男子有罪，法院作出了定罪判决。

该行人的家人现已在B州的联邦地区法院对该男子提起非正常死亡诉讼。家人已动议申请部分即决判决，主张州法院的判决对联邦法院具有约束力，以解决该男子是否违反其义务并导致行人死亡这一争议点。

A州允许非互惠性争议点排除。B州禁止非互惠性争议点排除。

联邦法院是否应批准家人的动议？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为联邦法院所在的州不允许非互惠性争议点排除。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为州法院的诉讼涉及刑事检控，而联邦法院的诉讼涉及民事索赔。
zh-choices.C: 应，因为该男子是否违反其义务并导致行人死亡的争议点，已在州法院的诉讼中得到实际诉讼和必要裁决。
zh-choices.D: 应，因为州法院的判决是本案法律原则（law of the case）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure / Preclusion
正确答案：C
应批准动议，因为争议点已在州法院诉讼中得到实际诉讼和必要裁决。

本题考查的是争议点排除（Issue Preclusion / Collateral Estoppel）在跨法域（State to Federal）情境下的适用规则。

⚖️ 核心法律逻辑
1. 法律适用规则 (Choice of Law)

这是解题的关键。根据完全信任与信用法案 (Full Faith and Credit Act, 28 U.S.C. § 1738)，联邦法院必须赋予州法院判决与该州法院相同的效力。

考点口诀：看判决是在哪里作出的（Rendering Court），就用哪里的法律来决定排除效力。

本案中，判决是A州作出的。因此，B州的联邦法院必须适用A州的排除规则。题目明确指出“A州允许非互惠性争议点排除”，因此该规则适用。

2. 刑事判决在民事诉讼中的效力

刑事定罪（Conviction）通常可以在后续的民事诉讼中产生争议点排除效力。

  • 证明标准：刑事案件的“排除合理怀疑”（Beyond a reasonable doubt）标准高于民事案件的“优势证据”（Preponderance of evidence）。
  • 结论：既然陪审团已经确信被告“排除合理怀疑”地导致了死亡，那么在民事案件中，这一事实自然成立。
3. 非互惠性争议点排除 (Nonmutual Issue Preclusion)

本案属于进攻性非互惠排除 (Offensive Nonmutual Issue Preclusion)。

  • 非互惠：原告（家人）不是第一场刑事诉讼的当事人。
  • 进攻性：原告利用先前的判决来“攻击”被告，确立被告的责任。
  • 规则：既然适用A州法律，且A州允许此类排除，原告可以直接利用刑事判决中的认定，无需重新举证。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误

选项 A 错误： 它错误地适用了B州（法院所在地）的法律。排除效力由作出判决的法院（A州）法律决定。

选项 B 错误： 刑事判决完全可以对后续民事案件产生排除效力，只要满足排除的要件（实际诉讼、必要裁决等）。

选项 D 错误： Law of the case（本案法律原则）仅适用于同一个案件的不同阶段。本题涉及两个独立的案件（刑事案和民事案），因此适用的是争议点排除，而非本案法律原则。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到“判决效力”（Res Judicata / Collateral Estoppel）的题目，首先问自己：
1. 谁作出的判决？（适用该地法律）
2. 谁在主张排除？（是原告还是被告？是否为原案当事人？）
3. 证明标准是否满足？（刑事定罪可用于民事，但刑事无罪释放通常不能用于民事排除，因为证明标准不同）。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A man took skydiving lessons over the course of several days. During the man's first solo jump out of an airplane without being attached to an instructor, the man panicked and ripped his backpack containing the parachute. The man was not able to release his parachute and died upon impact.
The man's estate brought a diversity action in federal court against the skydiving company requesting $3 million in damages. The estate demanded a jury trial. At the conclusion of trial, the judge gave the jury a verdict form that instructed the jury to determine which party should prevail and to answer specific questions related to each factual issue. When asked whether the man was contributorily negligent, the jury answered "Yes." When asked to give the percentage of the man's negligence, the jury answered "0%." The jury awarded the man's estate $3 million.
The applicable law requires damages to be reduced by the percentage of the plaintiff's contributory negligence.
What action should the court take upon receiving the jury's verdict and answers?

choices.A: Direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict.
choices.B: Disregard the jury's verdict and enter a judgment that is equitable.
choices.C: Enter a judgment in favor of the man but reduce the amount awarded based on the evidence.
choices.D: Enter a judgment in favor of the man for $3 million.

questions.explanation:
General verdict with answers
(FRCP 49(b))
Answers consistent with
verdict		 Judge must enter judgment consistent with verdict & answers
Answers inconsistent with
verdict		 Judge must:
• order new trial
• direct jury to further consider its answers & verdict or
• disregard verdict & enter judgment consistent with answers
Answers inconsistent with each other & verdict Judge must:
• order new trial or
• direct jury to further consider its answers & verdict
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

The presiding judge in a jury trial has the discretion to choose which type of verdict to use—a general verdict, special verdict, or general verdict with answers. If the judge selects a general verdict with answers and the jury's answers are inconsistent with each other and the verdict, the judge must order a new trial or direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict.

Here, the judge selected a general verdict with answers by instructing the jury to determine which party should prevail and answer specific questions related to the factual issues in the case. The jury found that the man was contributorily negligent and 0% negligent (inconsistent answers). The jury also awarded the man the full amount demanded with no reduction for his negligence, despite finding him contributorily negligent (answer inconsistent with verdict). Therefore, the court should direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict (Choice D).

(Choice B) When the jury's answers are inconsistent with the verdict, the judge may disregard the verdict and enter a judgment consistent with the answers. But a judge cannot enter a judgment that he/she thinks is equitable (ie, fair) because the jury is responsible for determining the factual issues.

(Choice C) A court may alter an allegedly excessive award of damages through remittitur, which gives the winning party a choice between a reduction in damages or a new trial on damages. However, the jury must first return a consistent verdict.

📌 Educational Objective

A general verdict with answers requires that the jury decide which party should prevail and answer specific questions on each factual issue. If the answers are inconsistent with each other and the verdict, the judge must either order a new trial or direct the jury to further consider its answers and verdict.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 49(b) (general verdict with answers).

一名男子参加了为期数天的跳伞课程。在该男子首次独立跳伞（未与教练相连）时，他惊慌失措，撕裂了装有降落伞的背包。该男子未能打开降落伞，在撞击地面时死亡。

该男子的遗产管理方以州籍多元管辖为由在联邦法院对该跳伞公司提起诉讼，要求赔偿300万美元的损害赔偿金。遗产管理方要求进行陪审团审判。在审判结束时，法官向陪审团提供了一份裁决表，指示陪审团确定哪一方应胜诉，并回答与每个事实问题相关的具体问题。当被问及该男子是否存在与有过失时，陪审团回答“是”。当被要求给出该男子的过失百分比时，陪审团回答“0%”。陪审团裁定该男子的遗产管理方获得300万美元的赔偿。

适用的法律要求，损害赔偿金应根据原告的与有过失百分比进行减扣。

法院在收到陪审团的裁决和回答后应采取什么行动？

zh-choices.A: 指示陪审团进一步审议其回答和裁决。
zh-choices.B: 不理会陪审团的裁决，并作出公平的判决。
zh-choices.C: 作出对该男子有利的判决，但根据证据减少裁定的金额。
zh-choices.D: 作出对该男子有利的、赔偿300万美元的判决。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：裁决与回答的不一致

Civil Procedure (民事诉讼法) FRCP 49(b)
核心考点：
当陪审团的“一般裁决”(General Verdict) 与其对具体问题的“书面回答”(Written Answers) 发生根本性冲突时，法官该如何处理？

1. 案情核心矛盾分析

本案中，法官使用的是附带回答的一般裁决 (General Verdict with Answers)。陪审团给出的结果存在严重的内部逻辑矛盾：

问题/裁决 陪审团决定 逻辑含义
是否存在与有过失？ Yes 原告有过错，应减少赔偿。
过失百分比？ 0% 矛盾！既然有“Yes”，怎么会是0%？
一般裁决金额 $300万 (全额) 与“Yes”的回答不一致。

2. 法律规则 (FRCP 49(b))

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第49(b)条，当回答相互不一致 (inconsistent with each other)，且其中一个或多个回答与一般裁决也不一致时，法官不能直接作出判决。

此时，法官只有两个选择：

  • 选项 A (正确)： 指示陪审团进一步审议其回答和裁决 (Return the case to the jury for further consideration)。
  • 或者： 命令进行新的审判 (Order a new trial)。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

❌ 选项 B (法官自行判决)：
法官不能无视陪审团的事实认定权。当事实认定自相矛盾时，法官不能代替陪审团去猜测他们的真实意图（是想判0%还是想判有过失？），因此不能直接作出“公平”的判决。

❌ 选项 C (减少赔偿金)：
虽然这听起来像“减额裁决”(Remittitur)，但在陪审团消除逻辑矛盾之前，法官无法确定该减多少，或者是否应该减。必须先解决矛盾。

❌ 选项 D (直接判 $300万)：
这会违反法律对“与有过失”的规定。陪审团已经认定原告有过失（回答 "Yes"），直接判全额赔偿与该事实认定冲突。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试中遇到 FRCP 49 题目时，请按以下流程判断：

  1. 看类型：是 Special Verdict (49(a)) 还是 General Verdict with Answers (49(b))？
  2. 找矛盾：
    • 回答与裁决一致 ➡️ 直接判决。
    • 回答内部一致，但与裁决冲突 ➡️ 法官可改判、重审或发回重议。
    • 回答内部冲突 (本题情况) ➡️ 必须 重审 或 发回重议 (不能直接判决)。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
At the conclusion of a federal civil trial, a 10-person jury returned a verdict in favor of the plaintiff for $22 million. Immediately after reading the verdict, the court polled the jurors individually to see if the verdict was unanimous. Every juror except for two stated that he or she agreed with the verdict.
After the poll was completed, the defendant moved for a new trial. The court denied the motion and directed the jurors to deliberate further. The plaintiff objected on the record. After two hours, the jury returned a verdict in favor of the defendant. The court polled each juror again, and every juror stated that he or she concurred in the verdict. The court entered a final judgment consistent with the verdict.
The plaintiff appealed, arguing that the trial court abused its discretion by polling the jurors and directing them to deliberate further after returning the first verdict.
Is the appellate court likely to overturn the judgment?

choices.A: No, because a trial court's discretionary decisions on issues pertaining to the jury are unreviewable.
choices.B: No, because the trial court had the power to poll the jury members and direct them to deliberate further.
choices.C: Yes, because the first verdict was overwhelmingly in favor of the plaintiff.
choices.D: Yes, because the trial court should have ordered a new trial when the jury failed to return a unanimous verdict.

questions.explanation:
Effect of jury polling (FRCP 48(c))

verdict
→

court orders poll
→
Poll reveals verdict
is unanimous

↙

consistent with verdict
Direct further deliberation
OR order new trial
Poll reveals verdict

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

Unless otherwise stipulated, a jury must reach a unanimous verdict. To determine whether a verdict is unanimous, the court may poll the jurors individually after a verdict is returned but before the jury is discharged. This must be done upon a party's request, or the court may do so on its own initiative (ie, sua sponte). If the poll reveals that the verdict is not unanimous, the court can either order a new trial OR direct the jury to deliberate further—as the court did here (Choice D). Therefore, the appellate court will likely affirm this judgment.

(Choice A) An appellate court may review a trial court's discretionary decisions on all issues (including issues pertaining to the jury) for abuse of discretion. Under this highly deferential standard of review, the trial court's ruling will only be reversed if it was clearly arbitrary or unreasonable. Since the trial court reasonably directed the jury to deliberate further, it did not abuse its discretion.

(Choice C) The fact that the first verdict was overwhelmingly in favor of the plaintiff is irrelevant because the verdict must be unanimous in the absence of a stipulation. Since there is no indication that the parties stipulated to a non-unanimous verdict, the trial court had the power to direct the jury to deliberate further.

📌 Educational Objective

A court must on a party's request, or may on its own initiative, poll the jurors individually after a verdict is returned but before the jury is discharged. If the poll reveals that the verdict is not unanimous, the court can (1) direct the jury to deliberate further or (2) order a new trial.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 48(c) (polling jurors).

在一起联邦民事审判结束时，一个由10人组成的陪审团作出了一项有利于原告的裁决，赔偿金额为2200万美元。宣读裁决后，法庭立即对陪审员逐一进行了问询，以确认该裁决是否为全体一致通过。除两名陪审员外，其他所有陪审员均表示同意该裁决。

问询结束后，被告提出进行新审判的动议。法庭驳回了该动议，并指示陪审团进行进一步商议。原告在记录中表示反对。两小时后，陪审团作出了一项有利于被告的裁决。法庭再次对每位陪审员进行了问询，所有陪审员均表示同意该裁决。法庭根据该裁决作出了最终判决。

原告提起上诉，主张初审法院在作出第一次裁决后，对陪审员进行问询并指示他们进一步商议，是滥用了其自由裁量权。

上诉法院是否有可能推翻该判决？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为初审法院就与陪审团有关的问题所作出的自由裁量决定是不可复审的。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为初审法院有权对陪审团成员进行问询，并指示他们进行进一步商议。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为第一次裁决以压倒性优势支持原告。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为当陪审团未能达成一致裁决时，初审法院本应下令进行新的审判。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Jury Verdicts & Polling

核心法律规则 (FRCP 48)

在联邦民事审判中，除非当事人另有约定，陪审团裁决必须是全体一致的 (Unanimous)。

当法庭对陪审团进行问询 (Polling) 且发现裁决并非全体一致时，法官拥有自由裁量权 (Discretion)，可以选择以下两种做法之一：

  • 指示陪审团继续商议 (Deliberate further)；或者
  • 下令重新审判 (Order a new trial)。
本案逻辑推演
1
现状：第一次裁决虽然是10人中的8人同意，但在联邦民事诉讼中，这属于非全体一致裁决 (Non-unanimous verdict)，因此该裁决无效。
2
法官的决定：面对无效裁决，法官拒绝了被告的新审判请求，而是选择了Fed. R. Civ. P. 48(c) 赋予的第二个选项：指示陪审团继续商议。
3
结论：法官的行为完全符合法律规定，不存在滥用自由裁量权 (Abuse of discretion)。因此，上诉法院不会推翻判决。
为什么选项 B 是正确的？

选项 B 准确描述了法律规则。初审法院有权（Power）在问询显示意见不一致时，指示陪审团回到商议室继续讨论。只要最终的裁决是全体一致的（本案中第二次裁决全票通过），程序就是合法的。

易错项辨析
❌ 选项 A (不可复审)：
错误。虽然法官有自由裁量权，但这并非“不可复审”(Unreviewable)。上诉法院可以审查法官是否“滥用”了该权利，只是本案中法官没有滥用。
❌ 选项 C (压倒性优势)：
错误。联邦民事审判要求全体一致 (Unanimity)。8:2 的比例虽然是多数，但在没有双方事先约定的情况下，依然是无效裁决。
❌ 选项 D (必须重审)：
错误。这是最强的干扰项。法律规定法官“可以”下令重审，也可以让陪审团继续商议，而非“必须”重审。法官选择了后者是合法的。
💡 MBE 考试通关秘籍
遇到 Jury Polling (陪审团问询) 的题目，请记住法官的“二选一”权力：
1. Deliberate Further (继续商议) ✅
2. New Trial (新审判) ✅

如果题目中法官选择了其中任何一条路，通常都不会构成滥用职权。只有当法官强迫持异议的陪审员改变立场（Coercion）时，才可能出错。
